businessGoal: Qualified Mac/Windows downloads and verified Pro purchases; browser completions are a separate product outcome.
rules: Diagnose buyer questions before creating content.
Improve an existing relevant page before adding another page.
Fix access and measurement problems on conversion paths first.
Classify external evidence as OWN, CLAIM, EARN or CONTEST before acting.
Keep Google performance, AI mentions/citations, referrals and product outcomes separate.

technicalFinding.finding: Valid toolkit routes in locales outside the eight marketing locales were being reported as /404/ in analytics.
technicalFinding.coverage: Exact route allowlist for all 22 translated toolkit locales, the hub, automation, and 36 tools; no broad locale wildcard.
technicalFinding.preservedIntentionalExclusions: Teams purchasing and account-specific controls remain noindex. The indexable product reference supplies the team-license decision answer.

OWN.action: Improve the existing product reference and fix measurement; retain useful existing pages.

CLAIM.action: Identify a relevant editable product listing from actual gap-answer citations before updating it.

EARN.action: Read recurring review or community citations and contribute only where relevant. No automated posting or new outreach performed in this change.

CONTEST.action: Record a specific incorrect statement and official correction evidence before requesting an update.

measurement.privacy: Analytics consent only; session storage expires after 30 idle minutes, with known page paths and fixed categories. No arbitrary referrer URLs, document data, user identity or raw campaign codes.
interpretation: download_click is intent, not a verified installer completion or activation.
purchase requires the existing paid first-party payment record.
AI referrals are observed referrers or explicit campaign tags, not proof of citation or model visibility.
Google referrals do not distinguish organic results, ads without click evidence, AI Overviews or AI Mode.
Missing referrers remain direct_or_unknown. Never infer AI traffic from direct visits.
The website does not join analytics to desktop installations, license activations or optional desktop usage identities.

reportingSetup.accessEvidence: Available Google Analytics login exposed earthquake, License Stamps, MenaMeet, and PE Genius accounts, not the PolyPDF property. No account permissions or credentials changed.

reevaluation.prompts: Reuse these exact buyer questions; record prompt, engine, date, country/language, answer status, mention, cited URLs, and brand presence on the source.
reevaluation.baselineStatus: No fresh observed AI answers in this implementation. Do not invent a before/after visibility lift.
reevaluation.cadence: Manual recheck after collection and indexing; no recurring paid schedule enabled.
reevaluation.comparison: Compare equal question/engine/market sets; use OpenSEO comparable-trend results rather than mixing independent runs.

validationLimitations: Mac mini Screen Sharing stopped updating its remote frame. Reconnecting prompted for authentication; no new Safari visual validation completed. SSH development and build validation remained available.
Existing desktop product identities remain separate; activated users cannot be attributed from website download clicks.
